title: What am I following him for?
html_source: He’s asking a deep question. What is he following Stephen for? Because he is exceptional. And Bloom cares about that. He wants a son. (nephew)

anchor.text: What am I following him for?
anchor.prefix: irst class with third ticket. Then too far. Train with engine behind. Might have taken me to Malahide or a siding for the night or collision. Second drink does it. Once is a dose.
anchor.suffix: Still, he's the best of that lot. If I hadn't heard about Mrs Beaufoy Purefoy I wouldn't have gone and wouldn't have met. Kismet. He'll lose that cash. Relieving office here. Good
